title: Receptionist
location: Rotherham, S65 1DJ, Rotherham, S62 7BT, Rotherham, S60 2JH, Rotherham, S60 8GD
description: Gateway Primary Care are looking to appoint a part-time receptionist / administrator to join our friendly team. This position would suit an hardworking and enthusiastic and caring person who likes to work in a busy patient facing role. Hours are between 8am and 6:30 pm Monday to Friday and we are looking for between 18 and 24 hours per week. Additional hours will be needed occasionally to cover holidays and sickness. GP Practice experience with SystmOne is desirable but not essential as full training will be given. Essential skills are; good telephone manner, ability to work well within a team and confidentiality. Salary dependent upon experience. Reception duties; face to face, answering telephone, booking appointments, care navigation, repeat prescriptions, dealing with incoming and outgoing mail, dealing with patient queries, registrations and deductions, tasks and other general administrative duties. Maintaining a safe and welcoming patient reception area. Adhering to the confidentiality policy.
